liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds Althea excellent; Reviewer hears Althea as routine, with little creativity from Jerry [7][9][16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the second set picks up with the Eyes into Fire pairing; Reviewer says the Eyes into Fire pairing alone is worth four stars [9][17]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (2 other sources): Uploader finds the standalone Fire quite beautiful and one of their favorite versions [1][2]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Reviewer notes some nice acoustic playing during Masterpiece [7]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer praises Bird Song as great [17]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry badly mangled the Terrapin lyrics [14]
- **Corrina** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry's vocals on Corrina sounded awful, likened to cats in heat [9]
- **The Days Between** (1 review): Days Between faded in Jerry's vocals and energy toward the end [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-03.sennME80.sturtevant-swayne.86000.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-07-03.sennME80.sturtevant-swayne.86001.flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 165 min [2]
- **gd1994-07-03.118758.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 143 min [3]
- **gd94-07-03.sbd.stevens.11691.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 159 min; rated 3.32/5 by 19 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard's sound quality outstanding; Reviewer says the soundboard fails to capture how the show felt in person; their audience tape sounded liquid [7][8]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls a warm summer night with a soft breeze; the short first set ran from Sunshine through Bird Song [8]
- Reviewer attended the show in person and finds the early second set strong [14]
- Reviewer had actual seats on July 2 and sat on the lawn this day; no encore was noted [16]
- Reviewer says the Sunday show started at 5 and, like the first two nights, had no encore [18]
- Reviewer speculates Shoreline's noise ordinance and fines for playing past 11 explain the lack of encores [18]
- Reviewer considers the second set quite good by 1994 standards [8]
- Attendee says the show looks great on paper like 7/2/94's Music>Sugaree>Music but wasn't played that hot [14]
- Reviewer calls it okay by 1994 standards, with a setlist that looks better than it played [15]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best shows of 1994, arguing shows should be compared only within the same year [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-03.sennME80.sturtevant-swayne.86000.flac16**: taped by Likely Neil Sturtevant; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Sennheiser Me-80s (could be 40s) > Panasonic SV-255 > Teac DA-P20 (clone) [1]
- **gd1994-07-03.sennME80.sturtevant-swayne.86001.flac1648**: taped by Likely Neil Sturtevant; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Sennheiser Me-80s (could be 40s) > Panasonic SV-255 > Teac DA-P20 (clone) [2]. Also: Sennheiser ME80 source by Sturtevant and Swayne, downsampled to 44.1k for CD burning; 44.1k version also seeded [2]
- **gd1994-07-03.118758.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones - up front/center> Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [3]
- **gd94-07-03.sbd.stevens.11691.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD > DAT [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-02 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-02-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - July 3, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/july-3-1994) [21]
